input.source:
sig A {}
Plus: run { #A = plus[1, 1] } for 3
Minus: run { #A = minus[3, 1] and some A } for 3
Mul: run { #A = mul[2, 2] } for 4
Neg: run { negate[#A] = -2 } for 3
Div: run { div[#A, 2] = 1 and #A = 3 } for 3
Rem: run { rem[#A, 2] = 1 and #A > 1 } for 3
Impossible: run { plus[#A, 1] = 0 } for 3

sig Account { balance: one Int }
Positive: run { some Account and all a: Account | a.balance > 0 } for 2 but 3 Int
SumFive: run { some disj a, b: Account | plus[a.balance, b.balance] = 5 } for 2 but 4 Int
Zero: run { some a: Account | a.balance = 0 } for 1 but 3 Int
TooLarge: run { some a: Account | a.balance > 7 } for 1 but 4 Int
assert Bounded { all a: Account | a.balance <= 7 }
BoundedHolds: check Bounded for 2 but 4 Int
Distinct: run { #Account = 2 and #Account.balance = 1 } for 2 but 3 Int

sig A {}
IntSize: run { #Int = 16 } for 1
SomeBetween: run { some i: Int | i > 2 and i < 4 } for 1 but 4 Int
NoneBetween: run { some i: Int | i > 2 and i < 3 } for 1 but 4 Int
TooNegative: run { some i: Int | i < -8 } for 1 but 4 Int
CountMatches: run { some i: Int | i = #A and i > 1 } for 3

sig A {}
Overflow: run { #A = 4 } for 4 but 3 Int
Wrap: run { plus[3, 1] = -4 } for 1 but 3 Int
Max: run { plus[2, 1] = 3 } for 1 but 3 Int
CountWrap: run { some A and #A < 0 } for 5 but 3 Int
NegWrap: run { minus[-4, 1] = 3 } for 1 but 3 Int
